new_learnings.text: Hot sector ≠ buyable stocks. 电网设备 #1 sector had 2 candidates, both in deep corrections with -10% limit-downs. When hot sectors have no technically sound entries, cash is correct.
new_learnings.mechanism: Sector momentum can persist while individual leaders correct — the sector ETF may be up but individual stocks that already ran are consolidating. Wait for the next wave of leaders.

new_learnings.text: dist_ma20 ≈ 0% combined with RPS20 > 95% is the highest-probability pullback entry pattern in the current pool. 凯莱英 fits this exactly.
new_learnings.mechanism: A strongly trending stock (high RPS20) that pulls back precisely to its 20-day moving average represents a mean-reversion entry at support within an uptrend. This is the Minervini 'volatility contraction' principle.

new_learnings.text: 科创50 -3.78% vs 上证 +0.25% confirms persistent sector rotation from tech to resources/defense. This divergence has held for 3 sessions — not a one-day blip. Zero semiconductor buys is correct.
new_learnings.mechanism: Index divergence reflects institutional repositioning — large funds are rotating out of tech growth into value/cyclical. This is a macro regime signal, not stock-specific.

new_learnings.text: V2's hard sector filter + MA extension filter eliminates ~80% of candidates immediately. Reduced decision fatigue and forced focus on the 2-3 best setups. This is the right operational model.
new_learnings.mechanism: Fewer decisions with higher conviction beats many decisions with low conviction. The framework's elimination logic is doing the heavy lifting.
